subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “War should not be made to look clean.”?
options: An earthquake museum was built in a town that had once been badly damaged.
No one knew who that person was, but several students smiled when they read it.
It is about learning how a reasonable person can think differently from you.
The helmet had once belonged to a person, not a character in a game.
